t: G46 Spacetime Portal Engine: Teleportation Budget Desk — Simple
name: G46 Spacetime Portal Engine: Teleportation Budget Desk — Simple
title: G46 Spacetime Portal Engine: Teleportation Budget Desk — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Quantum teleportation is real: one qubit teleported costs one entangled pair plus two classical bits. The desk budgets the entanglement and classical channel for any qubit count — the protocol's price is exact and small.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Classical bits for 1000 teleported qubits = 2000 bits. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: The Perpetual Spacetime Portal Engine (G46) – Quantifying the Portal Synchronicity Constant (PSC)
real_world_basis: Teleportation resource counting is the real, published quantum protocol.
signature_version: Signature version: the PSC teleportation desk — the chapter's Portal Synchronicity Constant as the fidelity target, with the portal framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: the classical channel must clear the bit budget — no superluminal anything.
math_note: Classical bits for 1000 teleported qubits: 2000 bits [verified]; Entangled pairs for 1000 qubits: 1000 ebits [verified]
safety: No hazard; the failure mode is calling it teleportation of matter — it moves states, not stuff.
how_it_works: Multiply the qubit count by 2 for the classical bits and by 1 for the ebits; budget the classical link from the Shannon capacity. The demo budgets a 1000-qubit transfer.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
Every numerical claim recomputed at build time
